description: Source code for the CatalogManager class in Apache Spark, managing catalog plugins, current catalog, namespace, and related configurations within Spark SQL connector.

classes.name: CatalogManager
classes.description: A thread-safe manager for catalog plugins, handling registration, lookup, current catalog and namespace management.

methods.name: catalog
methods.description: Retrieve a catalog plugin by name, with special handling for session catalog.

methods.name: isCatalogRegistered
methods.description: Check if a catalog with the given name is registered.

methods.name: loadV2SessionCatalog
methods.description: Load the V2 session catalog, possibly as an extension with delegate catalog.

methods.name: v2SessionCatalog
methods.description: Get or instantiate the V2 session catalog based on configuration.

methods.name: currentNamespace
methods.description: Get the current namespace, defaulting based on current catalog.

methods.name: assertNamespaceExist
methods.description: Verify that a namespace exists in the current catalog.

methods.name: setCurrentNamespace
methods.description: Set the current namespace, updating session catalog if needed.

methods.name: setCurrentCatalog
methods.description: Set the current catalog by name, resetting namespace and database as needed.

methods.name: listCatalogs
methods.description: List all registered catalogs, optionally filtered by pattern.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Reset the catalog manager state, clearing catalogs and resetting session catalog database.
